identify_diverse_bulk_structures.name: Identify Diverse Bulk Structures
identify_diverse_bulk_structures.description: Given a chemical composition (e.g., 'TiO2'), query the Materials Project database for potential bulk polymorphs. Focus on creating a diverse set that includes both stable and metastable structures (E_above_hull < 0.2 eV/atom) to ensure structural diversity in the dataset. Save results with thermodynamic properties as a JSON file.

create_bulk_structure_database.name: Create Bulk Structure Database
create_bulk_structure_database.description: Organize the identified polymorphs into a structured database with relevant properties. Include energy above hull, formation energy, space group, density, and electronic properties. Ensure proper metadata is recorded for traceability.

generate_symmetrically_distinct_miller_i.name: Generate Symmetrically Distinct Miller Indices
generate_symmetrically_distinct_miller_i.description: For each selected bulk structure, determine all symmetrically distinct Miller indices up to a specified maximum index (max_miller=3). This creates a comprehensive surface orientation sampling space for the dataset. Save results as a JSON file.

enumerate_systematic_slab_terminations.name: Enumerate Systematic Slab Terminations
enumerate_systematic_slab_terminations.description: Generate multiple surface terminations for each Miller index, ensuring systematic coverage of different surface stoichiometries and termination types. Create a structured database mapping unique identifiers to slab structures and properties.

calculate_structural_descriptors.name: Calculate Structural Descriptors for Slabs
calculate_structural_descriptors.description: Compute geometric and electronic descriptors for each slab, including coordination numbers, d-band centers, surface dipoles, and other features relevant for ML model training. Store these as feature vectors in a JSON file.

relax_selected_slab_structures.name: Relax Selected Slab Structures
relax_selected_slab_structures.description: Use MLFF to perform structure relaxation on a representative subset of slabs to obtain reference energies and optimized geometries. Balance computational cost with dataset coverage by selecting diverse representatives. Save relaxed structures and energies.

compile_adsorbate_library.name: Compile Adsorbate Library
compile_adsorbate_library.description: Create a library of relevant adsorbate molecules with optimized geometries and calculated gas-phase energies. Include molecules or fragments commonly studied in catalysis (CO, CO2, H, O, OH, N, NH_x). Save as a JSON file with molecular structures and properties.

create_adsorption_site_mapping.name: Create Adsorption Site Mapping
create_adsorption_site_mapping.description: Systematically identify and classify adsorption sites on each slab structure, creating a comprehensive mapping of site types (ontop/top, bridge, hollow) with their fractional coordinates.

generate_systematic_adsorbate_slab_confi.name: Generate Systematic Adsorbate-Slab Configurations
generate_systematic_adsorbate_slab_confi.description: Create a systematic set of single adsorbate configurations across different sites and orientations. Focus on ensuring diverse adsorption site coverage to create a balanced training dataset.

calculate_configuration_descriptors.name: Calculate Configuration Descriptors
calculate_configuration_descriptors.description: Compute adsorbate-specific descriptors for each configuration, including adsorbate-surface distances, binding atom coordination, charge transfer estimates, and orbital overlap indicators. Save as a feature vector database.

relax_adsorbate_slab_configurations.name: Relax Adsorbate-Slab Configurations
relax_adsorbate_slab_configurations.description: Use MLFF to relax selected adsorbate-slab configurations to generate reference energies and optimized geometries for ML training. Include both likely stable and some less favorable configurations for balanced data.

calculate_adsorption_energies.name: Calculate Adsorption Energies
calculate_adsorption_energies.description: Compute adsorption energies for all relaxed configurations to serve as target values for ML models. Ensure consistent references and correction schemes for the entire dataset.

generate_ml_ready_dataset.name: Generate ML-Ready Dataset
generate_ml_ready_dataset.description: Finalize the dataset in standard formats (JSON, CSV, or specific ML frameworks) with clear documentation of features, targets, and metadata to facilitate subsequent model development. Include training/validation splits.
